info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Correspondent Bank Operations API
info.description: The Correspondent Bank Operations API provides access to essential operations associated with correspondent banking transactions. Users can retrieve data related to payment processing, transaction statuses, and interbank agreements. This API is designed for banks and financial institutions looking to streamline their operations involving international payments and to enhance transparency in transactions. Typical consumers include banking applications, financial service providers, and any system requiring seamless integration with correspondent banking services.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific correspondent bank operation.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information regarding a specific correspondent bank operation identified by its unique reference number. Utilize this operation to examine transaction details, statuses, and relevant metadata to assist in financial operations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve operations related to a specific correspondent bank payment identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included for a successful operation.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the result is returned.
